facts.text: I'm intensely afraid of loud noises; they remind me of what I went through in Iraq.
It got so bad that I took leave from my army instructor duties.

facts.item: how long the symptoms have been going on
facts.text: These problems started roughly 7 weeks ago, after I got back from Iraq.
I've been avoiding places that bring back memories of the conflict, like practice shooting ranges.
Lately I've been refusing to leave the house unless my wife persuades me.
I feel constantly alert and on edge.
I feel guilty about things that happened during my deployment.
I don't have any significant medical problems.
I came back from active duty in Iraq 3 months ago.

facts.item: difficulty adjusting to life at home
facts.text: I've had a hard time adjusting to life back home after my military service.

findings.name: mental status examination
findings.result: Appearance: anxious, hypervigilant, avoids eye contact. Mood and affect: anxious mood; constricted affect. Thought process: coherent, goal-directed. Insight and judgment: fair insight; intact judgment.

findings.name: psychological assessment questionnaires
findings.result: Scores suggestive of PTSD, with high scores on the avoidance, intrusion and hyperarousal subscales.

leakage.reason: Psychological assessment result names PTSD (the gold diagnosis); it is the test's answer.

source_issues: objective_for_doctor mentions 'a mental health condition, following active duty service', which points to the trauma context.
notes: The chief complaint names two complaints (flashbacks, fear of loud noises); both are in the opening.
The 7-week duration applies to the dreams, anxiety and flashbacks and is a standalone fact; the return from Iraq 3 months ago is a separate social_background fact.
Psychological experiences are written as what the patient feels ('constantly alert and on edge'); the clinical labels (hypervigilance, avoidance) are aliases only.
Anxious, hypervigilant appearance and poor eye contact are in the mental status exam (x005); no acting note needed.
The four mental status leaves form one mental status examination record.

excluded_exam_lines.reason: 'No specific lab tests: Non-applicable for this case': no information.

extras.objective_for_doctor: Identify and manage a patient presenting with symptoms indicative of a mental health condition, following active duty service.
